correctness.rationale: Projection forces the right-factor relative generators, while finite-monoid unit factorization and monotone singular supports force an independent full set of S:H generators on every orbit of U(R). A matching coordinate-local construction proves equality, and exhaustive enumeration verifies the explicit 48-element counterexample.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The inspected recent source uses transitivity of the whole right monoid and does not state the unit-orbit formula. Targeted searches found special full-transformation and finite G-set results but not the exact general or iterated weighted formula. Closely related older and thesis literature remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact computable relative-rank formula, pinpoints a false general intermediate lemma in a current preprint, supplies explicit counterexamples, and explains why the paper's main full-transformation/symmetric specialization remains valid.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
